subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

While white blood cells are powerful people protectors, they has been not enough on their own.

options.text: powerful people protectors, they has been

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of "**has**" instead of "**have**".
 
• Since "**white blood cells**" is plural, it should be followed by "**have**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**they have been**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"While white blood cells are **powerful people protectors, they have been** not enough on their own."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "not enough on their own." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 2.
 
• **Option 4: "While white blood cells are,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
